description: Extend a budget's expiry window. Use this to keep a long-running agent alive past its original expiry. The new expiry must be later than the current one and at most 24 hours from now. Can be called repeatedly (e.g. extend by 2 hours every 2 hours for a 6-hour task). Returns 409 if the budget is CANCELLED or EXHAUSTED. Returns 400 if the new expiry is earlier than the current one.

expires_at.description: Absolute ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Mutually exclusive with expires_in.

expires_in.description: Relative duration from now (e.g. '2h', '30m'). Mutually exclusive with expires_at.

name: figuard_extend_budget
